scene.ko: 해외 거래처 담당자와 시차를 생각하며 계약 검토 통화 일정을 잡는다.

lines.en: Hi, Mark. I was hoping to set up a call next week to go over the contract. When would be good for you?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 마크 씨. 다음 주에 계약서를 같이 검토할 통화 일정을 잡고 싶은데요. 언제가 좋으세요?
alt: Hi, Mark. I'd like to schedule a call next week to review the contract. When are you free?

lines.en: Let me check my calendar. Tuesday and Thursday are pretty open.
lines.ko: 일정 좀 볼게요. 화요일과 목요일은 꽤 비어 있어요.

lines.en: Would Tuesday morning work? Maybe around nine, your time?
alt: How about Tuesday morning, around nine your time?
Is Tuesday at nine a.m. your time okay?

lines.en: That works for me, but isn't that 6 p.m. in Seoul? I don't want to keep you late.
lines.ko: 저는 괜찮은데, 그러면 서울은 저녁 6시 아닌가요? 늦게까지 붙잡아 두고 싶지 않아서요.

lines.en: That's very kind of you, but it's no problem. I usually work until seven anyway.
lines.ko: 신경 써 주셔서 감사하지만 괜찮아요. 어차피 보통 7시까지 일하거든요.
alt: Thanks for thinking of that, but it's fine. I usually work until seven.

lines.en: Great. How much time do you think we'll need?
lines.ko: 좋아요. 시간은 얼마나 필요할 것 같아요?

lines.en: About an hour should be enough. Should I invite your legal team as well?
lines.ko: 한 시간이면 충분할 거예요. 그쪽 법무팀도 초대할까요?
alt: An hour should be fine. Do you want me to invite your legal team too?

lines.en: Yes, please add Sarah from legal. I'll forward you her email address.
lines.ko: 네, 법무팀 세라를 넣어 주세요. 이메일 주소는 제가 보내 드릴게요.

lines.en: Perfect. I'll send out the invitation with a video link this afternoon.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 오늘 오후에 화상회의 링크를 넣어서 초대장을 보낼게요.
alt: Great. I'll send the invite with a video call link this afternoon.

expressions.en: I was hoping to set up ___.
expressions.note: set up a call · set up a meeting

expressions.en: When would be good for you?
expressions.note: 상대 일정을 먼저 묻는 공손한 말
시차가 있을 때 · 내 쪽은 my time
